host_profile: consumer Windows laptop, CPU inference, 64 GB RAM
method: single masked-token logits with independent binary coverage and categorical selection reads

native_image.input: one-pixel red PNG through the native SigLIP processor
native_image.notes: Baseline before caching; both reads recomputed vision features.

native_image_cached.input: same one-pixel red PNG and prompts as native_image
native_image_cached.notes: Projected vision features were reused and logits were identical. The remaining cost is dominated by two long multimodal language-model forwards.

native_image_batched.input: same one-pixel red PNG and prompts as native_image
native_image_batched.notes: One batched multimodal forward preserved the decision but was slower than cached sequential reads on CPU. It remains opt-in for accelerator benchmarking.
